verdict.rationale: Fern has a public GitHub repository (fern-api/fern), and an independent community comparison describes it as 'open-source, though not free,' so the core of the story is supported. The evidence never names the license or states which components (SDK generators, CLI, docs platform) fall under it, and 'not free' suggests parts may be commercial. Missing for 10: the specific open license (e.g., Apache/MIT), first-party confirmation of which product components are open source, and a statement on whether the hosted docs platform source is included.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Fern: Notable for being open-source, though not free.
Type-safe SDKs in multiple languages, including TypeScript, Python, Java, Go, Ruby, PHP, and C#
